## Code Review Findings

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (3)

<details><summary>3 items</summary>

It leaves out the tool-iteration-limit stop path, which emits `"Continue the task or ask me something else..."` (`agent/core/agent/agent.py` around lines 1128–1171). It also leaves out the starter-UI path, which emits `"Ask a question..."` (around line 336). The set itself is complete, so behavior is correct, but the latest commit says the comment now describes every turn-end path. (raised by 2/5 agents) <!-- inertness: first-conjunct=held limb-one=held limb-two=held; evidence: mechanism under discussion is the _GENERIC_INPUT_PLACEHOLDERS frozenset, already complete, so a corrected comment changes no output; git grep for _GENERIC_INPUT_PLACEHOLDERS found only _format.py lines 125 and 201 (code) and no tool or agent instruction file reading the comment; source comment never printed -->
